summary: ansible-core 2.15 deprecated giving vars: as a list of dictionaries; use a single dictionary.
questions: vars as a list gives a deprecation warning, how do I fix it?
Can I still define play vars as a list of dicts?

answer_card.title: vars must be a dictionary
answer_card.answer_md:
A list of dicts under `vars:` is deprecated. Use one mapping:

```yaml
# deprecated
vars:
  - var1: foo
  - var2: bar
# use
vars:
  var1: foo
  var2: bar
```
